scope: Same frozen canonical models and 500-flow cohort on the two previously used physical boards. Not the newly trained pair-disjoint Stage2 models.

cohort.sha256_meaning: Historical NPZ identity, not a hash of only row IDs
cohort.reference_predictions: Saved compiled-C predictions: replay correctness, not an independent estimator equivalence proof

includes: read one prepared row from Flash into a small RAM buffer
workload.calibration: Same active-batch function; target count rounded down to complete 500-row traversals
workload.correctness_before_each_run: Every one of 500 predictions must match the frozen compiled-C reference
workload.active_checksum: Actual prediction sum must equal whole-cohort prediction sum times complete traversals
workload.latency_estimate: MCU active duration divided by actual inference count from the same energy run

design.order_rule: Left rotate model_order by block index 0..4, fixed before acquisition
design.repeated_observations_are: Technical repetitions on one physical board, not independent boards, datasets or flows
design.stabilization: At least 30 seconds of quiet waiting after ARM and calibration before starting the recorded experiment
design.failure_policy: Stop immediately on software or board identity failure. Trace checks occur after the continuous CFN is saved. Retain incomplete and rejected sessions. No automatic acquisition resume across recorder restarts; new acquisitions get a new session. Analysis-only recovery never reflashes.
design.protocol_change_policy: Any changed harness or analysis gate requires a new version; retain previous attempts as pilots, do not silently pool
design.pilot_gate: Separate coefficient pilot excluded from summary. Its 500-reference prediction and batch checks gate further acquisition; its trace/energy gate is deferred until the entire recording is saved.

meter.connection: User confirmed unchanged USB power/data path from the previous campaign
meter.start_gate: On runner prompt start a NEW CFN; verify TIME grows; confirm in terminal within ten seconds of starting. If late, create a new recording before confirming. Keep recording until end prompt.
meter.marker: On-board LED, pulses 2/4/2 seconds with 2-second OFF gaps, outside active interval
meter.zero_load_diagnostic: Not a calibration. Optional separately labelled observation; not subtracted from the primary whole-board energy
meter.recording_scope: One fresh continuous CFN per physical board/session: pilot plus 25 campaign runs, including upload and stabilization gaps. Do not stop/restart between models.

analysis.primary_energy: Trapezoidal integral of VBUS times IBUS on CFN time coordinates between marker-registered active endpoints, divided by actual N
analysis.primary_energy_scope: Complete downstream USB-powered board/connection, including its regulator and indicators; engineering estimate
analysis.idle_diagnostics: Adjacent quiet intervals, LED off; report before/after power and optional signed baseline-subtracted estimate separately
analysis.registration: Whole-record marker candidates associated with MCU bookend separations and host monotonic run timings. Require unambiguous ordered attribution, then fit twelve individual edges per run. Host time identifies runs; energy endpoints use per-run MCU-to-CFN LED registration.
analysis.uncertainty: Registration residual and endpoint sensitivity are descriptive diagnostics, not a full instrument uncertainty budget or calibrated confidence interval
analysis.statistics: Show all five run-level results per model/board, mean and sample SD; no sample-level confidence interval from correlated 10-sps points
analysis.historical_comparison: Retain previous 20-flow energy and kernel-only latency separately. Do not combine power here with earlier latency or suppress historical C3 +7.58% result
forbidden_claims: peak RAM from linker static allocation

hardware cost of newly trained Stage2 models
continuous_limitations: Marker and trace quality are checked only after saving at the end; a software-passed pilot is not a trace-accepted pilot.
Continuous-recording capacity and reliability of the particular Windows FNB58 app are not validated by synthetic tests.
A stalled/restarted recorder can invalidate portions or the entire session; failed data are retained and never silently replaced.
